name: plotOHLC
title: High-low segment, open tick, and close tick. The check is those coordinates. Calendar labels treat the time unit as days since 1899-12-30.

origin.description: High-low segment, open tick, and close tick. The check is those coordinates. Calendar labels treat the time unit as days since 1899-12-30.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: High-low segment, open tick, and close tick. The check is those coordinates. Calendar labels treat the time unit as days since 1899-12-30.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
oh <- ts(cbind(Open = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), High = c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6), Low = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4), Close = c(1, 2, 1, 3, 2)), start = 2000, frequency = 1)
time.x <- time(oh)
dt <- min(lag(time.x) - time.x) / 3
n <- NROW(oh)
lab.ind <- round(seq(1, n, length.out = 5))
D <- as.vector(time.x[lab.ind] * 86400) + as.POSIXct("1899-12-30", tz = "GMT")
labs <- format(D, "%Y-%m-%d", tz = "GMT")
rows <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) paste(cell(time.x[i]), cell(oh[i, "High"]), cell(oh[i, "Low"]), cell(time.x[i] - dt), cell(oh[i, "Open"]), cell(oh[i, "Close"]), cell(time.x[i] + dt), sep = ","), "")
paste0(paste(rows, collapse = "|"), "#", paste(labs, collapse = ","))
